name: com.larje.spritemapsgenerator
description: Editor tool that generates normal and mask maps for 2D sprites and Spine atlas pages: procedural maps (bevel + detail) and AI normal maps (Marigold via a local Python environment), blended per texture with a slider. Open via Tools > Sprite Maps Generator. With com.unity.pipeline installed, generation is also exposed to agents as larje.sprite_maps Unity CLI commands (unity command larje.sprite_maps <name>).
